cohort: 39 women above 36 weeks of gestation admitted to hospital for induction of labour
finding: Intracervical gel had a shorter induction delivery time without impingement on the women's perception of induction.
mod_finding: Intracervical prostaglandin E2 gel for labor induction resulted in a shorter induction to delivery time compared to intravaginal administration, with no difference in mode of birth.
